description: This Java class 'HousekeeperReprocessingService' manages reprocessing of housekeeper tasks in the Thingsboard server, including message consumption, processing, error handling, and re-submission for reprocessing.

classes.name: HousekeeperReprocessingService
classes.description: Service class for handling reprocessing of housekeeper tasks, including message consumption, processing, error handling, and re-submission.

methods.name: afterStartUp
methods.description: Initializes message consumer subscription and starts the reprocessing process after service startup.

methods.name: processMsgs
methods.description: Processes a batch of messages, attempts task processing, handles exceptions, and commits the consumer.

methods.name: submitForReprocessing
methods.description: Re-submits a message for reprocessing, appending error information.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the consumer and shuts down executor service.
